The console is wrapped in clear plastic film.
A matching blue and grey camouflage-patterned DualShock 4 controller is shown.
The console appears to be a 500GB model, consistent with the Slim design.
The PS4 logo is visible on the top left corner of the console in photo 0.
The console is not powered on; the screen is blank.
The seller's text mentions '10 latest games' including FIFA and PES 2027, but no games are visible in the photos.

risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or unresponsive buttons.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or play a game.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the console's serial number and the 'PSN Status'.

Photo of the 'System Information' screen showing the serial number and PSN status.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
